## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks performed. For visual changes, include a screenshot. For engine changes, describe the Windows and monitor configuration used.

## Notes

Mention any limitations or actions users need to take.

For wallpaper submissions, include the template ID, creator, screenshot, asset licences, and preview/desktop/pause/performance checks from the [template submission checklist](https://github.com/Hytachi182/seeWallpapers/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/template.md).
